insights.quote: Men det märkte man verkligen var den bästa strategin, att när det väl största raset kom, och det har vi tjatat om i flera år, de här ETF-erna och när det vänder åt andra hållet, då måste man verkligen vara med.
insights.summary: The best strategy during big crashes is to stay invested in ETFs and quality stocks because when the market turns, you need to be positioned to benefit.
insights.speaker: Host 1

insights.quote: Där är väl en tankevurpa, många gör och framförallt marknaden gör och det är att cash är aldrig en bra tillgång. I alla fall inte i våra moderna ekonomier, eftersom att det är sådana där nedgångar motverkas alltid av att de pumpar massa pengar.
insights.summary: Cash is never a good asset in modern economies because downturns are always countered by money printing, which erodes purchasing power.

insights.summary: Having conviction in your trades allows you to buy when everyone is panic-selling, which is when the best opportunities arise.
insights.speaker: Host 1

insights.summary: When the market is volatile and everyone is panicking, the market is usually wrong, creating opportunities for contrarian investors.

summary: Episode 300 of Fill or Kill is a year-end review covering the COVID crash and recovery, personal investment performance, and market outlook. The hosts discuss their biggest wins and losses, analyze why holding through the crash and buying tech stocks was the right strategy. They review stocks from their New Year's portfolio including Neonode, Oasmia, Personalis, and Aurania. The episode discusses major trends like ESG investing, remote work, and the thematic nature of modern markets driven by ETF flows.
key_takeaways: Tech stocks rallied massively after COVID crash, while tourism and oil suffered
Having conviction and buying when others are panic-selling creates opportunities
Cash is a poor asset in modern economies due to money printing
The market is increasingly thematic and ETF-driven
ESG restrictions can create opportunities in excluded sectors like gambling and tobacco
Remote work trend is causing geographic relocation and tax competition
Best strategy was to buy quality tech during the crash and hold
